title: Nonarchimedean Lambert-series summability
statement: Let F be a complete normed field satisfying ‖x+y‖ ≤ max(‖x‖,‖y‖) for all x,y ∈ F. If q ∈ F satisfies ‖q‖ < 1, then for every natural number k the family indexed by d ∈ ℕ with term ((d+1 : F)^k q^(d+1))/(1−q^(d+1)) is summable in F.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type) [NormedField F] [CompleteSpace F], (∀ x y : F, ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖) → ∀ q : F, ‖q‖ < 1 → ∀ k : ℕ, Summable (fun d : ℕ => ((d + 1 : ℕ) : F) ^ k * q ^ (d + 1) / (1 - q ^ (d + 1)))
